At runtime rotate -90 degrees about X, centre uniformly and scale common assembly to maximum dimension 5.3. Isolation applies the same proper transform to a selected source component.

muscles.label: Skeletal muscles
muscles.description: 462 named source components of skeletal muscles, including bilateral heads and regions, face/jaw, trunk, limbs, deep back, neck, pelvic floor and extraocular muscles. Not a claim of every anatomical variant.
muscles.provenance: Coherent original Z-Anatomy muscle atlas; source-world transforms baked with proper unit/axis conversion. No anatomical decimation, deformation or mixing with another pose.
muscles.transformations: Baked source transforms, proper centimetre/Y-up to millimetre/Z-up conversion, exact float32 indexing, outward winding correction where needed, lossless meshopt encoding. No decimation, sculpting, pose changes or invented counterpart geometry.
